editorial.meta_description: The MAT Psychology Norms exam is retired as of 2023-11-15. There is no successor exam.
editorial.overview: The MAT Psychology Norms exam, certified by Miller Analogies Test, assessed knowledge across humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, and general vocabulary. This exam is retired as of 2023-11-15. The registry names no successor for this assessment. Candidates seeking current certification paths should contact Miller Analogies Test directly for information regarding available testing options, as this specific exam is no longer available for registration or completion under any circumstances for any candidate.
editorial.who_should_take: This exam was intended for graduate candidates requiring standardized assessment of their academic knowledge. As the exam is retired, no new candidates should prepare for or attempt to schedule this assessment. Consult Miller Analogies Test for current requirements.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Because this exam is retired and has no successor, no preparation strategy is applicable. Candidates should not study for this exam. If you require certification for graduate admissions, contact Miller Analogies Test to determine the current requirements or alternative assessments that may be accepted in place of this retired exam. Do not use old study materials.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The MAT Psychology Norms exam is retired and cannot be scheduled. Candidates should contact Miller Analogies Test to identify current testing requirements. Do not attempt to schedule this exam at any testing center.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consisted of exactly 120 partial analogy questions delivered in a multiple-choice, computer-based format during the standard testing appointment window for all registered candidates.
The provided official documentation does not specify a numerical passing score requirement for this retired examination format, as the test is no longer available for any new candidates.
The exam had a strict total duration of 60 minutes for candidates to complete all of the assigned multiple-choice questions during their scheduled session at the testing center.

faq.question_title: What was the cost of the exam?
faq.answer_text: The standard price was set at $90, though it typically ranged between $75 and $100 depending on the specific testing center location chosen by the candidate for their session.
